CORPORATOR · PRIMARY VISUAL BENCHMARK · V3.0

Hand-drawn technical information design.

This benchmark uses the supplied Economy diagram as the primary reference. The standard is the visual character of that sheet: handwriting-first typography, fine pen strokes, open composition, restrained color, and deliberate imperfection.

PRIMARY REFERENCE
Source of truth: the supplied Economy diagram. When an implementation choice is ambiguous, compare it to this image and ask whether the new element looks as though it belongs on the same sheet.

This is the actual primary reference supplied for the Corporator documentation visual system.

REFERENCE GRAMMAR

How the sheet is drawn

01

Hand-drawn flow

Open network, thin organic arrows, short annotations. No grid of cards.

02

Hand-drawn state

States are words, conditions sit beside transitions, lines remain thin and organic.

05 — REJECTION TEST

What must be rejected

Reject: rounded cards everywhere · icon + title + description grids · thick colorful arrows · gradients · shadows · glossy UI · default Mermaid styling · perfectly vector-clean rectangles · decorative color.

Ship: handwritten typography · fine pen strokes · open compositions · subtle asymmetry · sparse semantic accents · editorial tables · real math · bespoke SVG.
